_meta.purpose: ToolLLM-style synthetic instruction set for measuring tool-retrieval Recall@K over the dail-tracker MCP catalog (Qin et al. 2023, arXiv:2307.16789 — LLM-generated diverse instructions per API, retriever scored by Recall@K).
_meta.authored: 2026-07-31, by Claude from the live tools/list catalog. Each tool gets ~5 realistic user/agent phrasings; roughly two per tool deliberately avoid the tool's own name-words so description-vocabulary gaps surface as misses.
_meta.gold_rule: gold = the ONE tool that should serve the query per the catalog descriptions. Confusable clusters (payments grains, procurement views, diary tools) are authored to respect the never-sum/grain boundaries in CLAUDE.md.
_meta.caveat: Queries authored by the same model family that will consume the retriever — vocabulary leakage inflates absolute recall, so treat absolute numbers as optimistic; the RANKING of tools by recall is the actionable signal.
